# Source: Fragment

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Fragment
- **Artist / culture:** Egypt
- **Date:** 4th-5th century
- **Style:** coptic (historically identified as)
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 1841
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/1841
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/594987cd-fea0-dc02-97c6-9ca20aa73b79/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Egyptian Textile

## Extracted source palette

`#583828, #D8C8A8, #886848, #A88858, #B8A888, #685838, #988878, #382818`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#2E1D15`
- `surface`: `#463730`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#A88858`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#382818`
- `surface_variant`: `#463730`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#675A54`
- `error`: `#A88858`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `15.16:1`, surface `10.68:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.68:1`
- Control contrast: `5.89:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
